title: Pony.ai Unveils L4 Truck as It Courts European Tests
key_facts: Pony.ai unveiled a GAC-built electric Level 4 heavy truck (T9-based) at IAA Transportation in Hannover on 14 Sep
Volume production is planned later in 2026; European tests are under discussion, not approved
Reuters reported Pony.ai is talking to European governments and customers about road tests; no country, permit, customer or date named
Company says the autonomous kit costs 70% less to build than the previous generation and freight cost per ton-kilometre should fall 30% (a forecast)
No failure-rate, crash-rate or independent safety data published
quote_evidence: Pony.ai has unveiled a GAC-built electric truck with Level 4 automation and says volume production is planned later in 2026; European tests remain a discussion, not an approved deployment.
Sensor counts and redundancy describe design, not proven safety.
why_it_matters_hint: A new driverless truck model is shown and Europe is courted, but tests, permits and safety evidence are all still missing.
notes: Event is from 14 Sep (before 4 Oct); cost and safety figures are company claims. Article is an analysis piece quoting Reuters. Score cut 1.
